items.q: Is weed delivery legal in Bethesda, MD?

blocks.html: Yes. Since Maryland legalized adult-use cannabis, adults 21 and older can legally purchase and have cannabis delivered to private residences.

items.q: What do I need to provide for a delivery?

blocks.html: You must have a valid government-issued photo ID (Driver’s License, Passport, or Military ID) proving you are 21 or older. This must match the name on the order.
While delivery times can vary based on traffic and order volume, we strive for same-day delivery, often reaching Bethesda doorsteps in under 90 minutes.

items.q: Are there limits on how much I can order?

blocks.html: Yes, Maryland law limits personal possession to 1.5 ounces of flower, 12 grams of concentrated cannabis, or products containing up to 750mg of THC.
